UNIVERSITY LIBRARY LOAN POLICY
Each loan is decided by the rule for its category. Within a rule, every exception clause is only considered if the clause immediately before it applied; when an exception applies, its decision replaces the previous one.

Rule 1 (audio recordings): audio recordings items are approved by default. Exception: if the borrower currently has at most 17 items on loan, it is refused instead. Even then, if a digital copy is available, it is approved.
Rule 2 (microfilm): microfilm items are approved by default. Exception: if the item is not on a course reading list, it is refused instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if the borrower is a graduate student, it is approved.
Rule 3 (reference books): reference books items are refused by default. Exception: if the loan is longer than 55 days, it is approved instead. Even then, if no digital copy is available, it is refused.
Rule 4 (periodicals): periodicals items are refused by default. Exception: if the borrower currently has more than 23 items on loan, it is approved instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if the request is signed by an academic advisor, it is refused.
Rule 5 (maps): maps items are refused by default. Exception: if the borrower currently has at most 27 items on loan, it is approved instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if the loan is at most 14 days, it is refused.

CASE
- Loan 1 (category: microfilm) - borrower: a graduate student; on a course reading list: yes; item age: 61 years.
- Loan 2 (category: reference books) - on a course reading list: yes; digital copy available: yes; requested loan length: 60 days; requested during exam period: no.
- Loan 3 (category: maps) - requested during exam period: no; requested loan length: 13 days; request signed by: an academic advisor; items currently on loan: 30.
- Loan 4 (category: audio recordings) - items currently on loan: 17; digital copy available: yes; requested loan length: 46 days; item age: 45 years.
